_masks: [start_s, end_s, y_top, y_bottom]: hide Claude Code's grey prompt suggestions in the input line after the one human message
phases: The human sends one message: a goal and two examples.
Intake: herd init starts the task on its own branch, herd/slugify, and stores the request verbatim.
Criteria: C1 and C2 quote the human. C3 adds extra letters and separators, C4 bad input.
Red first: herd verify runs the checks before any code. 4 of 4 fail, so they test something.
Build: writes slugify. The first test run finds apostrophes splitting words; fixed.
Break it: the bad-input attack is logged with a test command; the other three are n/a, with reasons.
Review: a fresh-context subagent reads only the goal, the criteria and the diff.
Stop gate: Herd blocks finishing. The attack command was logged after the last verify.
herd verify: 4 of 4 criteria pass, and the bad-input attack command passes.
Review finds a Major bug: Greek, Cyrillic and CJK titles raise errors, so "any title" fails.
Fixes it, adds a regression test. herd verify: 4 of 4 pass.
herd done: evidence with the commit, the red-first count, the attacks and the known limits.
Final report: what changed, caveats, each decision, and where "any title" falls short.
